label: ACCEPT
reason: Procedures in accounting.ts, tags.ts and jobs.ts use protectedProcedure (session plus team-permission middleware in init.ts); six outliers use publicProcedure for token or link-id lookups (customer portal, invoice token, report links, short links) and banking.ts getProviderAccounts uses protectedOrInternalProcedure. All are reachable endpoints outside the auth wrappers, so they are exceptions a reviewer would want to confirm (R3). Biome does not enforce this.
